metadataReview.note: Add a named-site reference from the Korea Heritage Service record for the Byeokjegwan guesthouse site, whose official description identifies the place as the site of the Byeokjegwan battle between Ming and Japanese forces. The point marks the designated site, whose present remains belong to a 1625 rebuilding; it does not define the battlefield or any formation. The existing 27 February 1593 date is retained and no end date is added. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The Korea Heritage Service record for Goyang Byeokjegwan Guesthouse Site (Historic Site 144; 4,399 m²; 34-16 Byeokjegwan-ro, Deogyang-gu, Goyang) publishes its location-button parameters as longitude 126.900348095671 and latitude 37.7043209726772, rounded to [126.9003,37.7043]. Its official description states that the place was also the site of the Byeokjegwan battle between the Ming army under Li Rusong (Yi Yeo-song) and the Japanese. The same description dates the present guesthouse site to the 1625 relocation of Goyang county, so this is the state-designated named-site reference, not a proven 1593 position, a Ming or Japanese unit position, or the extent of the fighting. No accuracy radius is claimed.
